title: Sphere Packing Problem Higher Dimensions
exact_target: What is the greatest fraction of Euclidean space that equal nonoverlapping balls can occupy in each dimension greater than three?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1516 (GEOM-001). CC BY 4.0.

Maryna S. Viazovska, \emph{The sphere packing problem in dimension 8}, Annals of Mathematics 185 (2017), 991--1015; arXiv:1603.04246v2, Section 1, unrestricted packing density and the sphere-packing constant.
